purpose: Synthetic en-ja implicit browsing-admission scenarios. These fixtures test bounded backend personalization from already-resolved target lemmas; they do not test live page text extraction.

scenarios.name: no_history_neutral_p30
scenarios.description: Empty implicit store must preserve neutral profile-growth admission.

scenarios.name: implicit_food_only_p20
scenarios.description: Food reading trend without explicit topic preference should create a bounded browsing lane.

scenarios.name: explicit_food_only_p20
scenarios.description: Explicit food topic without implicit history is the control for topic preference.

scenarios.name: explicit_food_plus_food_p20
scenarios.description: Explicit food preference and implicit food trend agree.

scenarios.name: explicit_food_conflict_medicine_p20
scenarios.description: Explicit food preference with conflicting medical browsing trend.

scenarios.name: implicit_medicine_only_p45
scenarios.description: Medical reading trend without explicit topic preference.

scenarios.name: suppressed_signal_guard_p30
scenarios.description: A strong implicit signal must not select an explicitly blocked lemma.
